title: TV Advertising Trends for Small Businesses (2026)

facts.fact: Statista projects U.S. CTV ad spending to reach $33.35 billion in 2026, up from $28.75 billion in 2025.
facts.quote: U.S. CTV ad spending is projected to reach $33.35 billion in 2026, up from $28.75 billion in 2025 (Statista, 2025).

facts.fact: Statista's projection implies a 16% year-over-year jump in U.S. CTV ad spending, as stated on the page.
facts.quote: That's a 16% jump year over year.

facts.fact: According to the IAB's 2025 Video Ad Spend & Strategy Report, 55% of digital video buyers planned to increase their CTV budgets in 2025.
facts.quote: 55% of digital video buyers planned to increase their CTV budgets in 2025, with small and mid-size advertisers representing the fastest-growing buyer segment.

facts.fact: Adwave lets users launch a TV campaign with as little as $50.
facts.quote: Platforms like Adwave let you launch a TV campaign with as little as $50

facts.fact: The page states that creating a broadcast-quality commercial used to cost $5,000 to $50,000 or more before AI-generated creative tools.
facts.quote: Creating a broadcast-quality commercial used to cost $5,000 to $50,000 or more.

facts.fact: Adwave claims it can generate a polished 30-second TV spot in about two minutes.
facts.quote: Now you can generate a polished 30-second spot in about two minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave states its ads can run across more than 100 premium channels.
facts.quote: The quality is strong enough to run across 100+ premium channels

facts.fact: According to eMarketer (2025), programmatic CTV, which includes self-serve platforms, accounts for more than 75% of all U.S. CTV ad transactions.
facts.quote: programmatic CTV (which includes self-serve platforms) now accounts for more than 75% of all CTV ad transactions in the U.S. (eMarketer, 2025).

facts.fact: eMarketer says programmatic CTV's share of U.S. CTV ad transactions was roughly 60% two years before 2025.
facts.quote: That's up from roughly 60% just two years ago.

facts.fact: According to Nielsen's 2025 State of Play report, 68% of CTV ad impressions are delivered with some form of advanced audience targeting beyond basic age and gender.
facts.quote: 68% of CTV ad impressions are now delivered with some form of advanced audience targeting beyond basic age and gender.

facts.fact: According to the IAB's 2025 Measurement & Attribution Report, 72% of CTV advertisers use multi-touch attribution models.
facts.quote: 72% of CTV advertisers now use multi-touch attribution models, up from 48% in 2023.

facts.fact: According to Variety (2025), Tubi, Pluto TV, and the Roku Channel collectively reach over 100 million monthly viewers in the U.S.
facts.quote: Platforms like Tubi, Pluto TV, and the Roku Channel now collectively reach over 100 million monthly viewers in the U.S. (Variety, 2025).

facts.fact: The page states the average CPM across streaming platforms ranges from $15 to $35.
facts.quote: The average [CPM across streaming platforms](https://adwave.com/resources/tv-advertising-cpm-by-platform) ranges from $15 to $35

facts.fact: According to Parks Associates, 62% of U.S. broadband households used at least one FAST service in 2025.
facts.quote: 62% of U.S. broadband households used at least one FAST service in 2025, up from 50% the prior year.

facts.fact: A 2025 LG Ad Solutions study found QR code scan rates on CTV ads increased 42% year over year.
facts.quote: QR code scan rates on CTV ads increased 42% year over year, with the highest engagement coming from local service and retail advertisers.

facts.fact: According to AdImpact (2025), the 2024 election cycle put an estimated $12.3 billion into political advertising.
facts.quote: The 2024 election cycle dumped an estimated $12.3 billion into political advertising, with CTV absorbing a record share (AdImpact, 2025).

facts.fact: The page states that AI creative tools let advertisers launch a TV campaign in under 10 minutes.
facts.quote: AI creative tools mean you can launch a campaign in under 10 minutes and start learning immediately.

facts.fact: The page cites a 2025 Video Advertising Bureau (VAB) study finding that advertisers who added CTV to their digital mix saw a 22% lift in overall campaign performance (third-party claim).
facts.quote: According to a 2025 VAB (Video Advertising Bureau) study, advertisers who added CTV to their digital mix saw a 22% lift in overall campaign performance.

facts.fact: The page says platforms like Adwave have lowered the minimum TV ad spend for small businesses to $50.
facts.quote: Platforms like Adwave have brought the minimum spend down to $50, and FAST channels have created a large pool of affordable inventory.

facts.fact: The page gives a CPM range of $15 to $35 for small business TV campaigns, with no named source.
facts.quote: With CPMs ranging from $15 to $35, a small business can run a meaningful local TV campaign for a few hundred dollars a month.

facts.quote: a small business can run a meaningful local TV campaign for a few hundred dollars a month.
